title: Lanzones Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Lanzones Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Lanzones nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and potassium in lansones, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Lanzones nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your lansones (lanzones) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, zinc and boron. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Potassium deficiency on a leaf, shown on another crop as a stand in for lanzones

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium and phosphorus move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But zinc and boron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which lanzones nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Shows first on the young leaves

blocks.caption: Deficiencies that start on the young leaves of lansones

New leaflets come out small, narrow and bunched, yellow between the veins.

Shoot tips stunt and die back, flowers and young fruits drop, and some fruits crack or come out misshapen.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a lanzones nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest lanzones nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in lanzones

No lanzones particular description was found, so this follows general fruit tree signs. The whole tree turns light green, then the older leaves yellow evenly and fall, and the yellowing moves up the tree. Young trees put out few new leaves, and the leaflets stay small. Bearing trees flower and fruit poorly. You see it most at this stage: young trees under coconut or banana shade, and old trees after a heavy crop.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in lansones

Trees that get little or no fertilizer show it most. In a long PCA trial in Davao, leaf nitrogen of bearing trees fell below the normal level after a heavy fruiting year, because the fruit takes up so much.
How to tell it apart

Heavy shade also gives thin, pale trees. Check how much light the tree gets. To be sure, leaf test using the third leaf from the top of a tertiary branch, as in the PCA trial. PCA gives about 2.7 percent nitrogen as the normal level for bearing lanzones.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

For young trees, a Southern Mindanao University trial found that two doses of 25 to 100 grams of nitrogen per tree (about 55 to 220 grams of Urea 46 0 0) gave more and bigger leaves. Bearing trees in the PCA Davao trial got a complete fertilizer with chlorine, sulfur and boron (14 5 20) plus organic fertilizer or coconut husks every year. Apply in a ring under the canopy after weeding, and water it in.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, fertilize every year, with an extra dose after a heavy crop.
Potassium deficiency in lanzones

No lanzones particular description was found, so this follows general fruit tree signs. The tips and edges of older leaflets yellow and then dry brown, and the scorch moves inward. Fruit set and fruit quality drop, so bunches carry fewer, smaller fruits. You see it most at this stage: bearing trees, most of all during and right after fruit growth.
Why potassium deficiency happens in lansones
Fruit carries a lot of potash away. In the PCA Davao trial, leaf potassium of lanzones dropped below normal in a heavy fruiting year as the nutrient moved into the developing fruit.
How to tell it apart

Dry wind and drought also brown leaf edges, mostly on the exposed side of the tree. Fertilizer burn from a heavy dose close to the trunk shows soon after application. To be sure, leaf test of the third leaf from the top of a tertiary branch. PCA gives about 2 percent potassium as normal for bearing lanzones.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Give potash every year, following the soil test. The PCA Davao trial used a 14 5 20 fertilizer and, in some years, 80 grams Muriate of potash 0 0 60 with 400 grams rock phosphate per tree, split between June and October. A Philstar farm column describes growers using 17 0 17 and Muriate of potash 0 0 60 at about 1 kg per 10 kg of expected fruit, with the last dose at least two months before ripening.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, add potash after each harvest and again before flowering, and keep a mulch ring of leaf litter.
Phosphorus deficiency in lanzones

No lanzones particular description was found, so this follows general fruit tree signs. Growth is slow and the tree stays stunted. Older leaves turn dull with a purple or bronze tint, most of all on the underside. In the PCA trial, trees with more leaf phosphorus flowered and bore better. You see it most at this stage: young trees, and bearing trees on very acid soils before flowering.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in lansones
Very acid soils that hold phosphorus tightly. Soil under lanzones in the PCA Davao trial ranged from about pH 4.1 to 5.8.
How to tell it apart

Cold, drought and root damage also slow growth and tint leaves, so check the roots and soil moisture. Nitrogen deficiency makes old leaves pale yellow, not purple. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus and pH, and a leaf test. PCA gives about 0.2 percent phosphorus as normal for bearing lanzones.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Apply a phosphorus fertilizer in the ring under the canopy, following the soil test. The PCA Davao trial added 400 grams of rock phosphate per tree in split doses in some years, together with a complete fertilizer and organic matter. Lime very acid soils so phosphorus stays available.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, mix compost and phosphorus into the planting hole.
Zinc deficiency in lanzones

No lanzones particular description was found, so this follows general fruit tree signs. New leaves come out small and narrow, yellow between the veins. Bunch together at the shoot tip because the shoot fails to lengthen. Flowering and fruit size suffer. You see it most at this stage: new flushes on bearing trees, especially after a heavy crop.
Why zinc deficiency happens in lansones
In the PCA Davao trial, leaf zinc of lanzones fell below normal in fruiting years. Langsat grows poorly and turns chlorotic on limestone and other alkaline soils.
How to tell it apart

Iron or manganese deficiency also yellow young leaves between the veins, but leaves keep their normal size. Mites and thrips can stunt and curl new leaves. To be sure, leaf test of the third leaf from the top of a tertiary branch. PCA gives about 32 ppm zinc as normal for bearing lanzones.
What to apply for zinc deficiency

No lanzones particular rate was found. A soil dose of 50 grams Zinc sulfate per tree in the PCA trial did not raise leaf zinc of young trees. So a foliar spray is the surer route. Spray Zinc sulfate on new flushes, following the label. TNAU sprays for other fruit trees use 3 to 5 grams Zinc sulfate per liter.

Sold here with zinc: **Harvester Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Universal Harvester, Inc. (22 percent zinc), **Great Planters Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Agway Chemicals Corp. (21 percent zinc), **Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate** by Petbowe Trading Corporation (33 percent zinc) and **YaraVita ZINTRAC 700** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (40 percent zinc). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer with zinc](/blog/micronutrients-for-rice), and the page on [zinc deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/zinc-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, avoid very heavy phosphate, keep organic matter up, and check leaf zinc every few years in bearing orchards.
Boron deficiency in lanzones

No lanzones particular description was found, so this follows general fruit tree signs. Boron moves little in the tree, so the shoot tips, young leaves and young fruit show it first. Growing tips stunt and can die, young leaves are small and brittle, flowers and fruitlets drop. Fruits may crack or grow out of shape. You see it most at this stage: flowering and early fruit set, and after a heavy crop.
Why boron deficiency happens in lansones
In the PCA Davao trial, leaf boron of lanzones fell below normal after heavy fruiting. Sandy or leached soils low in organic matter, long dry spells and heavy liming bring it on.
How to tell it apart

Fruit drop also comes from drought at flowering, bark borer damage and poor care. PCAARRD notes that watering during flower bud emergence in dry months improves fruiting. To be sure, leaf test of the third leaf from the top of a tertiary branch. PCA gives about 54 ppm boron as normal for bearing lanzones.
What to apply for boron deficiency

No lanzones particular rate was found. Use a fertilizer that carries a little boron, as the PCA trial did with its 14 5 20 blend, or spray Solubor or Borax on the leaves before flowering, following the label. Do not repeat high doses without a test, because too much boron is toxic.

Sold here with boron: **Solubor** by Caldic Philippines Inc. (21 percent boron), **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (11 percent boron), **YaraVita BORTRAC 150** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (11.1 percent boron) and **Grow More Liquid Chelate Boron** by Sagrex Corporation (10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep organic matter up, water during flowering in dry months, and test leaf boron every few years.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any lanzones nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories and the Bureau of Soils and Water Management test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your lansones needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Lanzones nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my lansones leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: pale yellow green trees with few, small new leaves, and the older leaves yellow and drop. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at zinc deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in lanzones?
items.a: For young trees, a Southern Mindanao University trial found that two doses of 25 to 100 grams of nitrogen per tree (about 55 to 220 grams of Urea 46 0 0) gave more and bigger leaves. Bearing trees in the PCA Davao trial got a complete fertilizer with chlorine, sulfur and boron (14 5 20) plus organic fertilizer or coconut husks every year.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in lanzones?
items.a: Give potash every year, following the soil test. The PCA Davao trial used a 14 5 20 fertilizer and, in some years, 80 grams Muriate of potash 0 0 60 with 400 grams rock phosphate per tree, split between June and October.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in lanzones?
items.a: Apply a phosphorus fertilizer in the ring under the canopy, following the soil test. The PCA Davao trial added 400 grams of rock phosphate per tree in split doses in some years, together with a complete fertilizer and organic matter.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my lansones lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the lanzones nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
